{"version":1,"taskId":"9f3b1b9c-b600-47d6-a4bf-302656fda9b9","commandId":"publish-1","operation":"publish","headSha":"e0a720a0b8185824d35e09937c677a9ed3d5752e","message":"fix(runtime): drive sliding walls, doors and pendulums from the hole clock\n\nHoleRuntime treated only spinner/windmill/gate/platform as moving, so sliding-wall,\ndoor and pendulum descriptors got fixed bodies and stood still. isMoving now covers\nevery MovingObstacle type via an exhaustive record, and update() is built on the\npure helpers: rotationAngle() from obstacles/rotating for rotate and swing motion\n(pendulums carry their body along the arc around the pivot) and sampleMover() from\nobstacles/movers for translate motion, which brings loop, once and end pauses.\nAdds moverPose() to read a kinematic pose back and a test covering the three types."}
